title: Capacity Pulse: onboarding cards and animated state transitions for Dedicated
creator: Miguel R. Santos
description: Design a compact set of onboarding artifacts named 'Capacity Pulse' — interactive mini-cards and short animated transitions that explain Dedicated capacity setup, autoscaling behavior, and SLA tiers. Deliverables: Figma components (cards, icons, progress pulses), Lottie/MP4 motion snippets for 3 states, microcopy for each card, alt text & accessible color tokens, and a handoff package for front-end implementation. Focus on concise first-touch education for new Dedicated customers, low cognitive load, and clear error/fallback paths.
comments: 2026-03-01 - Miguel R. Santos: Initial ticket created after kickoff with PM. Defined scope and required outputs. Linked PRD and requested engineering constraints (max asset size for motion=250KB, Lottie preferred).
2026-03-04 - Aisha N. Park: Uploaded wireframes + first-pass microcopy. Noted need to avoid jargon in card titles; suggested three-tier metaphor (Pulse, Surge, Reserve) but flagged for PM signoff.
2026-03-06 - Lena K. Ortiz (PM): Requested rename from 'Surge' to 'Burst' to match product docs. Asked to include explicit fallback wording when autoscale is disabled.

2026-03-08 - Miguel R. Santos: Iteration 2 uploaded to Figma. Added motion spec pages with 600ms entrance, 200ms hover micro-interaction, and 350ms collapse. Reduced color contrast on pulse token to meet AA when combined with label text.

2026-03-10 - Eng review (Rajat P.): Feeback: prefer SVG animated strokes instead of Lottie for initial launch due to bundle constraints; asked for a static PNG fallback for older browsers. Added dependency to ENG-30590 for telemetry hook to surface card impressions.

2026-03-11 - Accessibility review (Dana M.): Confirmed color tokens pass AA for normal text when using high-contrast label mode. Asked to provide keyboard focus states and ARIA descriptions for each card.
2026-03-12 - Aisha N. Park: Preparing handoff package. Need final PM sign-off on microcopy and SLA band names. Marking In Review and requesting review from Design lead and PM.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file contains a component library with responsive card variants (mobile/tablet/desktop) and documented tokens for color/typography.
Three motion snippets produced (Entrance, Autoscale toggle, SLA expand/collapse) as Lottie and SVG+CSS variants, each with a <=250KB static fallback.
Microcopy and CTA strings approved by PM and localized-ready (string keys provided).
Accessibility checklist completed: keyboard focus, ARIA labels, color contrast tokens, alt text for each static fallback.
Handoff bundle uploaded to Drive and linked PR created for docs embedding examples; front-end has clear asset names and implementation notes.
Telemetry hooks and impression events referenced (dependent on ENG-30590) and a follow-up QA ticket created for cross-browser tests.
